title: tui/spinner — v1
description: Declares which patterns in the PTY/screen text indicate the agent is actively generating. The daemon's status state machine fires `generating` when any pattern matches inside the configured scope window. Codex's `Working (8m 56s • esc to interrupt)`, Claude's braille spinner, and Antigravity's `Thinking…` are all expressible with this primitive.

patterns.description: List of patterns. Any match within the scope window classifies the screen as generating.

regex.description: ECMAScript regex source. Daemon compiles with the flags below.

description.description: Author-facing note explaining when this pattern fires.

scope.description: Where in the text the patterns are searched. Defaults to `live-frame-tail` which mirrors the safest production behaviour (avoids matching scrollback or earlier turns).

oneOf.title: Live frame tail
oneOf.description: Last N lines of the visible screen, where N is `scopeWindowLines` (default 8). Recommended for most providers.

oneOf.title: Whole screen
oneOf.description: Match anywhere in the current screen text. Use with caution; tends to false-positive on scrollback.

oneOf.title: Recent buffer
oneOf.description: Last ~1000 chars of accumulated buffer. Useful when the spinner is in raw byte stream but not in the rendered screen yet.

scopeWindowLines.description: Number of trailing lines considered the live frame when scope is `live-frame-tail`.
